method.geometry: min(number of valid >=25 ha pivots with centroid inside official municipal mesh / 5, 1)
method.availability: min(distinct dates whose scene fully covers every selected pivot and eo:cloud_cover <=40 / 48, 1)
method.continuity: number of 2023-2024 months with a fully covering scene at scene cloud <=40 / 24
method.proximity: max(0, 1 - cluster-centroid geodesic distance from Caxias sede / 600 km)
method.cost: 0.5 / number of distinct MGRS tiles among usable scenes + 0.5*max(0, 1 - cluster radius /20 km)
method.targets_rationale: 5 pivots matches established pilot sample; 25 ha matches existing native-20m pixel budget; 48 dates is two candidate dates per month for cloud fallback, 24 months measures continuity. 600 km is the regional distance scale, 20 km is a compact pilot radius relative to a 100km Sentinel tile. Scores compare engineering feasibility, not statistical validity.
method.eligibility: At least 3 valid >=25ha pivots with verified municipal centroid; at least 6 months of fully covering cloud<=40 scenes; exact SCL acceptance and calibration require subsequent pixel-level pilot.
method.selection_rule: highest weighted score among eligible candidates; ties by distance then municipal code
method.warning: Scene cloud is only a planning proxy. No per-pivot quality, seasonality, index or regional model validation is inferred.

summary.models: not fitted; no regional generalization metrics
